load_test.detail: the model loaded and generated text
load_test.prompt: Say hello in one short sentence.
load_test.text: Hello! It's a pleasure to meet you!
load_test.attribution: AlphaAI llama.cpp Engine (Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct GGUF) — underlying model: Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct-GGUF (created by Alibaba)

criteria.source_requirement: official publisher repository on Hugging Face, open-weight license, not gated

selection.decision: Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct, quantised to Q4_K_M GGUF (qwen2.5-0.5b-instruct-q4_k_m.gguf, 491400032 bytes) and run by the AlphaAI llama.cpp Engine.
reasons: Size matches the recommendation: `alphaai doctor` reports up to 1.3B parameters at q4_k_m and recommends 0.5B on this CPU-only machine.
Q4_K_M is the preferred quantisation and is published officially for this model, which is not true of the nearest alternatives.
Runtime is compatible: llama-cpp-python is installed and loads this GGUF on CPU with about 1.05 GB headroom in 1.94 GB of RAM.
Official, open-weight source: the Qwen team (Alibaba) publishes it on Hugging Face under Apache-2.0, ungated.
Capabilities cover AlphaAI's surfaces: chat, streaming and tool calling, which the engine verifies with a real load test.

alternatives_considered.why_not: Above the 0.5B recommendation: its Q4_K_M file is 1117 MB, so weights plus runtime overhead would not leave usable headroom on a machine with 0.56 GB available RAM.
The official repository ships only Q8_0 (639 MB); no Q4_K_M, so it costs more memory and time, and Qwen3 thinking traces are impractical at roughly 9 tokens/second on one core.
Official repository ships only Q8_0 (386 MB); smaller and weaker on coding and tool calling than Qwen2.5-0.5B at a similar footprint.
Gated on Hugging Face (account and licence acceptance required) and 1B is larger than the recommended 0.5B for this machine.

notes: The real local model AlphaAI talks through on CPU-only machines: Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct, quantised to Q4_K_M GGUF and run by llama.cpp. AlphaAI owns the engine integration, not the weights; the model was created by Alibaba (Apache-2.0) and AlphaAI never claims otherwise. It is a 0.5B-parameter model: it chats, answers simple maths and writes short code, but its reasoning depth is limited by design.
